housing.summary: Numbeo reports average monthly rent of S$3,820 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Singapore). A 2026 Singapore rental guide describes the market convention as one month of security deposit per lease year (https://lovelyhomes.com.sg/renting-condo-singapore-guide-2026/). PropertyGuru Group identifies PropertyGuru.com.sg as Singapore's No. 1 property marketplace (https://www.propertygurugroup.com/newsroom/pandemic-uncertainty-spurs-property-ownership-enquiries-from-singaporeans-and-the-need-for-expert-guidance/).

banking.summary: DBS's official newcomer page says foreign applicants without Singpass upload a passport biodata page (or Malaysian IC), a valid Employment Pass, S Pass, Student's Pass or in-principle approval, proof of residential address, and proof of tax residency (https://www.dbs.com.sg/personal/deposits/for-foreigners/new-to-singapore).
required_docs: Passport biodata page (or Malaysian identity card for Malaysians)
Valid Employment Pass, S Pass, Student's Pass, or in-principle approval from MOM or ICA

schools.summary: Singapore American School documents US Common Core and Next Generation Science Standards (https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1728271922/sas/hpccldqjh4xetmvwgcxw/Elementary-School-Program-Guide_2024-25.pdf); Tanglin Trust documents a UK-style English National Curriculum with (I)GCSE and A Level or IB Diploma pathways (https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1742884495/ttsedusg/wsaoq0dblqozufrruybx/AdmissionsPolicy.pdf); UWCSEA documents (I)GCSE followed by the IB Diploma Programme (https://www.uwcsea.edu.sg/curriculum-microhome/what-parents-should-know). The MOE registry can be searched to verify registered private schools (https://www.moe.gov.sg/private-education/private-schools).
curricula: US Common Core and Next Generation Science Standards

legal_admin.summary: ICA requires travellers, including work-pass and other long-term-pass holders arriving by air or sea, to submit the SG Arrival Card with electronic health declaration within three days including the day of arrival, unless an exemption applies (https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/sg-arrival-card).
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the SG Arrival Card with electronic health declaration within three days including the day of arrival before arriving in Singapore; listed exemptions apply.

tax_finance.summary: IRAS identifies an individual's tax reference number as an NRIC or FIN for employee tax services (https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/employees). A foreign individual without a Singapore Government-issued ID who needs digital access for individual or property tax must apply to IRAS for a Singpass Foreign user Account using a national ID or passport, email address, and any existing IRAS tax reference number (https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/others/singpass-foreign-user-account-(sfa)-for-foreign-individuals).

transport.summary: LTA describes Singapore's public transport system as rail and bus networks (https://www.lta.gov.sg/content/ltagov/en/who_we_are/our_work/public_transport_system.html). SimplyGo prices the Adult Monthly Travel Pass at S$122 for unlimited train and basic bus travel, but eligibility is limited to Singapore citizens and permanent residents (https://simplygo.com.sg/concession-monthly-travel-cards/adult/adult-monthly-travel-card/). Traffic Police says foreigners resident for under 12 months generally need not convert a valid foreign licence; conversion requires a valid foreign licence and passing the Basic Theory Test (https://www.police.gov.sg/Knowledge-Hub/Traffic/Traffic-Matters/Singapore-Driving-Licence). At SingHealth Polyclinics, a new patient makes an appointment and presents original identification such as a work permit at registration (https://polyclinic.singhealth.com.sg/clinic-visit/what-you-need-to-know).
transport.network_name: Singapore public transport rail and bus networks (MRT/LRT and public buses)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A foreigner residing in Singapore for less than 12 months generally need not convert a valid foreign driving licence; conversion requires a valid foreign licence and passing the Basic Theory Test, subject to Traffic Police criteria and documents.
transport.healthcare_registration: For a new-patient visit at a public SingHealth polyclinic, make an appointment, then present original identification such as a work permit at the registration counter.
